independent_claim_checks.claim: PG&E Considers Gas Business Separation Amid California Wildfire Liability Rules
independent_claim_checks.source_excerpt: Article 0 Comments PG&E Corp. said it may spin off, sell or otherwise separate its natural gas business if California doesn’t overhaul its wildfire liability rules. The utility’s 4 million gas customers are bearing borrowing costs associated with the company’s sub-investment-grade credit because the business sits within a holding company exposed to wildfire risk, Chief Executive Officer Patti Poppe said Thursday on a call with investors. “That seems like an issue that should be resolved one way or another,” Poppe said.
